title: CROSS-ARCHITECTURE MODEL DIFFING WITH CROSSCODERS: UNSUPERVISED DISCOVERY OF DIFFERENCES BETWEEN LLMS
findings: Using a novel cross-architecture model diffing technique, the study discovered that the Qwen3-8B model contains specific, model-exclusive features that encode Chinese government narratives about the persecution of religious groups, specifically Falun Gong practitioners and Uyghur Muslims. These features were causally validated through activation steering, which could alter the model's output to be more aligned with or critical of these narratives.
